#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> multiply(const vector<int>& first, const vector<int>& second, int mod) {
    int required = first.size() + second.size() - 1;
    int size = max(2, 1 << (32 - __builtin_clz(required - 1)));
    
    vector<double> reA(size, 0.0), imA(size, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < first.size(); i++) {
        long long val = ((long long)first[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        reA[i] = val & 0x7FFF;
        imA[i] = val >> 15;
    }
    performFFT(reA, imA, false);
    
    vector<double> reB(size, 0.0), imB(size, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < second.size(); i++) {
        long long val = ((long long)second[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        reB[i] = val & 0x7FFF;
        imB[i] = val >> 15;
    }
    performFFT(reB, imB, false);
    
    vector<double> resRe(size, 0.0), resIm(size, 0.0);
    vector<double> tmpRe(size, 0.0), tmpIm(size, 0.0);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int j = (size - i) & (size - 1);
        
        double a1r = (reA[i] + reA[j]) * 0.5;
        double a1i = (imA[i] - imA[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2r = (imA[i] + imA[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2i = (reA[j] - reA[i]) * 0.5;
        
        double b1r = (reB[i] + reB[j]) * 0.5;
        double b1i = (imB[i] - imB[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2r = (imB[i] + imB[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2i = (reB[j] - reB[i]) * 0.5;
        
        resRe[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        resIm[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        tmpRe[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        tmpIm[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }
    
    performFFT(resRe, resIm, true);
    performFFT(tmpRe, tmpIm, true);
    
    vector<int> output(required);
    for (int i = 0; i < required; i++) {
        long long aa = llround(resRe[i]);
        long long bb = llround(tmpRe[i]);
        long long cc = llround(resIm[i]);
        output[i] = (int)((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod);
    }
    return output;
}

void performFFT(vector<double>& re, vector<double>& im, bool inverse) {
    int n = re.size();
    int bits = 32 - __builtin_clz(n);
    vector<int> rev(n, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        rev[i] = (rev[i >> 1] >> 1) | ((i & 1) << (bits - 1));
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        if (i < rev[i]) {
            swap(re[i], re[rev[i]]);
            swap(im[i], im[rev[i]]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int half = len >> 1;
        vector<double> cosines(half), sines(half);
        double sign = inverse ? -1 : 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
            double angle = 2 * M_PI * i / len * sign;
            cosines[i] = cos(angle);
            sines[i] = sin(angle);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                double wR = cosines[j];
                double wI = sines[j];
                double uR = re[i + j];
                double uI = im[i + j];
                double vR = re[i + j + half] * wR - im[i + j + half] * wI;
                double vI = re[i + j + half] * wI + im[i + j + half] * wR;
                
                re[i + j] = uR + vR;
                im[i + j] = uI + vI;
                re[i + j + half] = uR - vR;
                im[i + j + half] = uI - vI;
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (inverse) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            re[i] /= n;
            im[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}

class InputReader {
private:
    istream& inputStream;
    char buffer[1024];
    int index, count;
    
public:
    InputReader(istream& is) : inputStream(is), index(0), count(0) {}
    
    int readNext() {
        if (index >= count) {
            inputStream.read(buffer, sizeof(buffer));
            count = inputStream.gcount();
            index = 0;
            if (count <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buffer[index++] & 0xFF;
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        int c = readNext();
        while (c <= 32) c = readNext();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') { sign = -1; c = readNext(); }
        int value = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("Invalid input");
            value = value * 10 + c - '0';
            c = readNext();
        } while (c > 32);
        return value * sign;
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader scanner(cin);
    
    int n = scanner.nextInt();
    int k = scanner.nextInt();
    
    vector<int> base(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int val = scanner.nextInt();
        base[val] = 1;
    }
    
    vector<int> result = {1};
    int exponent = n / 2;
    
    while (true) {
        if (exponent & 1) {
            result = multiply(result, base, MOD);
        }
        exponent >>= 1;
        if (exponent == 0) break;
        base = multiply(base, base, MOD);
    }
    
    long long sum = 0;
    for (int value : result) {
        sum = (sum + (long long)value * value) % MOD;
    }
    cout << sum << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
